limitations.note: The rewrite fixes the repeated green reload but also asserts red immediately on reset and removes the original startup delay, whereas the reference fix changes only the green reload condition.
The rewrite keeps the ports but removes the original public state parameters, so existing instantiations that override them would no longer compile.
The test expects the rewrite's immediate red assertion, so it passes without catching the reset and startup timing mismatch with the reference.
